text: Project loading screen: opaque two-bar progress from click until the graph or list DOM is ready, no stale or empty lists
description: Opening a project shows the old project's lists, then empty states, then partial lists. One openProject path with a load token, fetch-then-commit, restored view chosen before mount, and a detail and overall progress bar.

status.comment:
Does the loading screen look and feel right on your machine, in both list and graph view?

Evidence: pnpm check 25/25. Playwright e2e against the running stack: 18 of 19 passed in the full run; the one failure (reload-restore's visibility check) passed alone and in 3 repeats, so it looks timing-dependent. Frame-by-frame browser log on a slowed socket: no empty lists or old-project text after the screen left, in either direction checked (fixture text gone after switching back to v7); saved graph view never mounts the columns view; overall bar only moves forward; rapid switch ends on the last project; Escape returns to the picker; a bad path shows the failed state; with animation frames disabled the 20 s timeout releases the screen. Not reproduced: one Puppeteer session (headless, no animation frames) stayed on Laying out lists past the timeout, cause unknown. Known limit: in a browser with no saved positions the graph still opens zoomed in while nodes spread.
